reading.text: At the embassy, an adult learner handles a real-world responsibility and must make a clear decision. First, the adult learner considers Application, Identification, Form, and Interpreter. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Guard, Clerk, Attaché, and Flag. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Reception, Ceremony, Treaty, and Negotiation. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Alliance and Summit. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. By the end, the adult learner can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
